name: Harbour Wall
rules: Blocks the first Fog creature each round.

name: Lighthouse
rules: Once per round, reveal the next Fog card.

name: Fish Market
rules: Keepers here heal 1 damage each round.

name: Old Pier
rules: Keepers here can move to any place.

name: Boathouse
rules: Store up to two cards here, face down.

name: Chapel Bell
rules: Ring it to clear one fog from the town.
